title: Phase 15: The Escape Vector
body: The secret ending resolves the final contradiction offstage through the concealed coalition's intervention. No direct confrontation occurs; instead, the tension dissipates in the shadows of the narrative structure. This phase marks a silent victory where the antagonist's power is neutralized without explicit acknowledgment within the main text surface. It preserves the mystery while ensuring logical consistency for the downstream branches that rely on this resolution state.
